name: Osama al-Waaedh
bio: Osama ibn Mustafa al-Waaedh is a teacher and poetry reciter based in Bahrain. He studied hadith and writes about poetry, including the place of description in early Arabic verse. His recordings range from Ali ibn al-Jahm’s “Eyes of the Oryx” to poems by al-Mutanabbi and Ahmed Shawqi. In “I Saw People Lean” he works as both reciter and poet, taking up an old play on words and carrying it into contemporary life.
